definitions.explanation: The act of evaluating one's own abilities, performance, or worth. Common in workplace, education, and psychological contexts.

examples.japanese: {自己|じこ}{評価|ひょうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{自己|じこ}{評価|ひょうか}シート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I submit a self-evaluation form at the end of the year.

examples.english: If your self-evaluation is too high, a gap can arise between your perception and that of those around you.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in two main contexts: (1) workplace performance reviews where employees assess their own work, and (2) psychology, referring to a person's sense of self-worth or self-esteem.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自己|じこ}{評価|ひょうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (to have a high self-evaluation)
- {自己|じこ}{評価|ひょうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (to have a low self-evaluation)
- {自己|じこ}{評価|ひょうか}シート (self-evaluation form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自己|じこ}{肯定|こうてい}{感|かん}→自己肯定感：16006_jikokouteikan⟧: self-affirmation, self-esteem — focuses on positive self-regard
- ⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧: evaluation — the general term without the self-referential element
